name: interface_user_feedback_learning
purpose: Project bounded interaction feedback into local preference evidence. Disabled or reverted items become avoid evidence, non-disabled pins become lock evidence, accepted/pinned items not avoided become prefer evidence, and ignored items not otherwise classified remain neutral. The result is local evidence only, not a user-trait inference or automatic shell change.
principles: explicit disable and revert outweigh inferred preference
pins are explicit stability evidence unless disabled
ignored is neutral rather than negative
preference evidence stays local and bounded to observed interface items
feedback learning does not actuate the interface
